The antibody was raised against the paired helical filaments (PHF) core, which retains its characteristic morphological features and consists mainly of tau protein. The molecules to be crystallized for the structure were core PHF tau unit tau306-391 and the MN423 Fab. But, tau306-391 was not found in the crystal. It is likely that it was digested during crystallization by an endoproteolytic activity present in the crystallization drop. This was why only the structure of the MN423 Fab fragment was refined. There was no clear electron density for the heavy chain C-terminal residues 223-225. In parallel, the PHF core C-terminal pentapeptide 387-391 was docked into the binding site of MN423. There was clear electron density at the antibody binding site which corresponded well to the position of the in silico modeled pentapeptide 387-391. Further refinement gave a unique structure with an excellent fit to the electron density, suggesting full occupancy and allowing to build-in also the sixth residue T386.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 1.65 angstroms
